label: H.R. 2140
title: Diesel Emissions Reduction Act of 2025

latest_action.text: Received in the Senate. Read twice. Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 624.

summary: Diesel Emissions Reduction Act of 2025 This bill reauthorizes through FY2029 a diesel emissions reduction program under which the Environmental Protection Agency provides grants, rebates, or loans for replacing diesel engines or retrofitting the engines with pollution control technologies.
summary_short: Diesel Emissions Reduction Act of 2025 This bill reauthorizes through FY2029 a diesel emissions reduction program under which the Environmental Protection Agency provides grants, rebates, or loans for replacing diesel engines or retrofitting the engines with pollution control technologies.
